articles.title: A Spacecraft Uses Earth to Speed Toward Jupiter
articles.summary: The Juice spacecraft swung past Earth and used its gravity to speed up toward Jupiter.

articles.title: Oklahoma's Hidden Meteor Crater Is Younger Than Scientists Thought
articles.summary: Tiny crystals show a meteor crater under Oklahoma is about 370 million years old, not 467.5 million.

articles.title: A Forgotten Forest Experiment Grew Giant Trees
articles.summary: An old Australian experiment found that thinning a forest helped the remaining trees grow huge.
